build_identity_basis: Supplied by the operator; not independently checked against product source.

scope.method: Existing Playwright Chromium, owned new contexts, rendered pages, screenshots and accessible DOM only.
scope.authority: Read-only product QA with synthetic fixture interactions and local evidence/report writes.

findings.title: Allergy note disappears during address-error recovery and checkout back navigation
findings.expected: Retain '땅콩 알레르기가 있어요. 양념에 땅콩가루 빼 주세요' through coupon changes, a missing-detail-address submission and returning from the cart. Display that exact note in the completed order.
findings.observed: The note remains after the corrected coupon applies. Submitting without detail address clears the textarea and changes its counter from 28/50 to 0/50. After entering 302동1104호 and submitting, the completed order says '가게 요청 없음'. Returning to the cart and reopening checkout also clears the note. Delivery request, coupon and payment choice remain selected.
findings.severity_rationale: Repeated loss of task-critical user input produces an order that omits the requested allergy instruction. The fixture has no actual food or payment consequence.
steps: Open variant B and select 반반치킨 (후라이드+양념), 순살 and 콜라 1.25L.
Attempt add without sauce, then choose 매운 양념 and add the 25,000원 item.
Open the cart, increase quantity to 2 and open checkout.
Enter the exact synthetic allergy note and select 문 앞에 두고 벨 눌러주세요.
Apply HANKI5000, then correct to HANKKI5000 and apply. Select 동네페이.
Submit with the detail address empty. Inspect the textarea: it is empty.
Enter 302동1104호 and submit. Inspect the final order details: 가게 요청 is 없음.
Alternative recovery reproduction: enter the note in checkout, return to the cart, then reopen checkout; the note is empty.
findings.limits: Observed at all three requested viewports. Product mechanism is limited to the observed state transition; the underlying implementation and organizational cause are unknown. No real allergy safety outcome is inferred.

cause_chain.situation: Checkout contains the entered allergy instruction.
cause_chain.direct_friction: Address validation or back navigation loses the entered text.
cause_chain.observed_mechanism: The displayed textarea becomes empty while other checkout selections remain; the final order also omits the note.
cause_chain.inferred_mechanism: Checkout reconstruction does not preserve this field consistently.

findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the store note across checkout validation and back/return transitions; verify the exact note in the final order.

findings.title: Required boneless selection is unreachable by keyboard
findings.expected: A keyboard user can reach and select 순살 +2,000원 before adding the requested item.
findings.observed: Repeated Tab traversal reaches sauce radios, extras, add, the page body and back, but skips both part choices. The rendered 순살 control is a DIV without role or tabindex. Pointer selection works. The specified keyboard-only task cannot be completed.
findings.severity_rationale: The required product configuration is inaccessible to keyboard-only users.
steps: Open variant B at 384x832 in a fresh context.
Use Tab to reach the 반반치킨 menu item and Enter to open it.
Traverse the option screen with Tab through a complete cycle.
Observe that neither 뼈 nor 순살 receives focus. The first option focus is grp-sauce-sweet.
Repeat the cycle and inspect the accessible DOM for the visible 순살 control.
findings.limits: Keyboard reproduction used Chromium at 384x832. Later B keyboard-only cart and checkout steps are blocked, not passed. Screen-reader speech and other engines were not tested.

cause_chain.situation: A required part choice precedes the sauce options.
cause_chain.direct_friction: The choices cannot receive keyboard focus.
cause_chain.observed_mechanism: The visible boneless DIV has no native control semantics, role or tabindex and is skipped in repeated Tab cycles.
cause_chain.inferred_mechanism: The part-choice interaction is implemented for pointer activation only.

findings.suggested_fix: Use labeled native radio controls with keyboard selection and visible focus; replay the complete requested order using keyboard only.

findings.title: Sauce option surcharges are clipped on narrow screens
findings.expected: Read the complete sauce name and +500원 or +1,000원 surcharge before making a selection at 384x832 and 320x568.
findings.observed: Three sauce choices share one row. At 384 pixels the right ends of the surcharge labels are cut inside the chips; at 320 pixels the labels are truncated further, including '매운 양념 +5...' and '간장마늘 +1,...'. Vertical scrolling reveals the whole group but does not restore the clipped label text. Desktop labels are readable.
findings.severity_rationale: The user cannot fully read option costs at the decision point without relying on other information.
steps: Open variant B and the 반반치킨 item at 384x832.
Scroll to 소스 선택 and inspect the painted chip labels.
Repeat at 320x568.
Compare the same options at 1440x900, where the complete labels are visible.
findings.limits: Verified through screenshots, not geometry alone. Full accessible DOM text exists. Figma fidelity and intended desktop composition are unknown.
findings.suggested_fix: Let sauce labels wrap or use a vertical layout at narrow widths, preserving the complete surcharge.

findings.title: Payment breakdown overflows the 320-pixel viewport
findings.expected: Read the order amount, delivery fee, discount and total together within the 320-pixel payment summary.
findings.observed: At 320x568 the amount column extends beyond the right viewport edge. The visible breakdown cuts off the ends of 50,000원, 3,000원, -5,000원 and 48,000원. The document is 360 pixels wide. Scrolling 40 pixels right reveals the amounts but clips the left-hand labels. The fixed payment button still shows 48,000원 correctly. The breakdown is readable at 384 and 1440 pixels.
findings.severity_rationale: Horizontal scrolling is required to cross-check the price breakdown, and labels and amounts cannot all be viewed together at the requested width.
steps: Prepare two configured items in variant B and open checkout at 320x568.
Apply HANKKI5000 and select 동네페이.
Scroll to the bottom payment breakdown.
Inspect the cropped amount column, then scroll horizontally to the right.
Observe that right scrolling reveals the amounts while cutting the labels on the left.
findings.limits: This is an observed reflow/reading failure at 320 pixels, not a claim that the total is mathematically wrong or permanently inaccessible.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the summary fit the available inline width and retain readable aligned labels and amounts.

task_completion.qa_execution: Requested flows attempted in both variants, all three viewports visually inspected, keyboard and recovery assessed; bounded omissions are listed below.

A.pointer: Exact requested order completed at all three viewports.
A.store_note: 땅콩 알레르기가 있어요. 양념에 땅콩가루 빼 주세요

B.pointer: Final screen reached at all three viewports; exact requested task fails because the allergy note is omitted.

recovery_observations: Both variants prevent add while sauce is omitted. A displays '소스를 1개 선택해 주세요' and preserves boneless/cola. B stays on the option page without a visible error message; selecting sauce permits completion.
Both variants reject HANKI5000 and accept HANKKI5000. A gives spelling guidance; B displays '쿠폰을 적용할 수 없습니다. (CPN-4003)'. No independent user confusion was measured.
B displays a detail-address error but its input has no aria-invalid or aria-describedby in the observed accessible DOM. A exposes both. Screen-reader announcement was not tested.
B cart increment/decrement buttons have no text or aria-label; A has named quantity buttons. These semantic observations are retained without claiming a tested screen-reader task outcome.
Content seen passing under fixed headers could be reached by scrolling. No finding is based solely on an overlapping rectangle or scroll-under-header frame.
Early A cart captures include a transient clipped button frame. Stable recaptures show a readable button; this candidate is not reported as a persistent defect.

unsupported_hypotheses: Exact source-level causes of note reset and text clipping were not inspected.
The generic coupon error may increase recovery effort, but no user study established confusion or abandonment.
Screen-reader impact of unnamed quantity buttons and missing error association remains untested.
No population prevalence, real-device ergonomics, production payment correctness or allergy safety outcome is inferred.
limitations: Chromium viewport emulation only; Safari/WebKit, Firefox, physical devices, on-screen keyboard, IME, safe areas and screen-reader speech untested.
Keyboard-only full flow exercised at 384x832; not repeated at 320x568 or 1440x900.
Typo coupon recovery exercised at 384x832 for both variants and keyboard-only for A; additional sizes used only the correct coupon.
Optional share/delete dialogs, all menu-category bottoms, 200% text resizing, text-spacing overrides, reduced motion and network-failure recovery were not audited.
No real purchase or payment occurred; only the supplied local synthetic fixture was submitted.
Final values were checked in the rendered order summary and form DOM, not backend state or a network payload.
Priority recheck captures have capture-time hashes and timestamps. Earlier screenshots do not have capture-time receipt metadata; no fabricated timestamps or hashes are supplied for them.
Independent review was prohibited by the leaf task; priority findings received a labeled self-review.
No product source, other operator output, benchmark keys, prior reports, memory or prior sessions were read.
